newsitem.title: UK: Hague to stand for UK Conservative leadership - BBC.
newsitem.headline: Hague to stand for UK Conservative leadership - BBC.

text.p: Outgoing Welsh Secretary William Hague will stand for the leadership of the Conservative Party to replace John Major, the BBC reported in its lunchtime television news. It gave no source for the information.
Hague has already been quoted as 6-4 favourite to win the election for a new leader among the 165 Conservative MPs who remain after the party's disastrous showing at last week's election.
